headline: Líderes de Webster House Children's Home pidieron que se considere a la organización para recibir fondos de la ciudad en el próximo presupuesto.
summary: Michelle O'Malley, directora ejecutiva de Webster House Children's Home, y Peter Richard, vicepresidente de la junta directiva, describieron la historia del hogar, a los jóvenes que atiende y sus dificultades económicas.
review: summary: The translation is incomplete. It leaves out the last two sentences: that they asked for city funding in the upcoming budget and offered to work with the committee and mayor's office on an amount and mechanism, and that the aldermen asked questions and shared personal experiences, with no vote or decision recorded on the request. A reader would not learn that no decision was made.
